description: This file defines a UI view component 'ToDo.NotepadFooterView' using Enyo framework, representing the footer section of a to-do list application, including task count display, filters, and a 'Clear completed' button.

classes.name: ToDo.NotepadFooterView
classes.description: Enyo kind component representing the footer view with task counts, filters, and a button to clear completed tasks.

methods.name: clearCompleted
methods.description: Handles the 'Clear completed' button tap event, bubbles an event to parent components, prevents default event behavior.
